Ana (Docs): PR 7382 preview failed: dashboard example throws 'unknown field latency_buckets' during render.
Rory (Eng-Obs): we migrated to latency.histogram last sprint; docs missed a handful of tiny examples.
Luca (SDK): opening a micro-PR to update node/python/go snippets. will include a one-liner sed for bulk updates.
Ana (Docs): please also update the small 'cost vs latency' example in the quickstart - users copy that.
Luca (SDK): added sed suggestion: `sed -i 's/latency_buckets/latency.histogram/g' ./docs/**/*.yaml` and a before/after diff in the migration section.
Mina (QA): after merge can someone paste the quick curl I can run? `curl -s -X POST https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/api/render -d '{"example":"dash-latency"}'`
build-bot: PR 7382 preview: render-check failed (snippet schema error)
Luca (SDK): PR 7384 opened with snippet updates + sed example. left a short comment about backward shim availability.
Rory (Eng-Obs): removed an internal redirect that pointed to /console/obsv/legacy-latency; search now returns the updated path.
Mina (QA): smoke after merge: HTTP 200 and response shows `{"latency":{"histogram":[0.005,0.05,0.5]},"cost":{"units":9}}` - no errors.
Ana (Docs): thanks. merging once CI green. will add a small note in release notes about latency_buckets -> latency.histogram for visibility.
